fieldValues.title: Options
fieldValues.article_text: The options that had genuine support, each saying what it leads to. Never "none": if nothing competed, the option was leaving things as they are. Checked by: mechanical for at least two options, a status-quo option and a 'leads to' on each; judgement for whether support is genuine.
fieldValues.rationale: From the owner's meeting review and the owner's rule in vignette 8d4deae4: a decision presents a case for any option. Finding 9b9f9434 measured a case per option at 41%.
